breakdown.description: The case is for a particle settling downwards in a fluid column (Y-axis), but the gravity vector points upwards, which would cause the particle to accelerate upwards instead of settling.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the incorrect gravity vector. The simulation is for a particle settling downwards along the Y-axis, which requires a negative value for the Y-component of gravity. The agent repeated the incorrect value from the original prompt, `(0 9.81 0)`, instead of correcting it to `(0 -9.81 0)` as specified in the ground truth.
